verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes mention a built-in AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, so the product does ship its own in-product assistant. That evidence is a single one-line release-note mention. The MCP server only exposes Galileo to external IDE assistants and does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks can be delegated to the assistant, whether it can act (create experiments, datasets, metrics) versus only advise, its UI and workflow details, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant.
